results.title: RailroadROW
results.description: The RailroadROW feature class contains polyline features representing the edge boundaries of railroad right-of-way corridors in Franklin County, Iowa. These features reflect the general alignment of railroad property used for rail transportation, as recorded in county and state transportation records. The dataset is maintained to support land records management, planning and zoning, transportation studies, and emergency response operations. RailroadROW data also provides an important base layer for integrating transportation networks with parcels, utilities, and roadway infrastructure in the county GIS. results.title: FCCBProperty
results.description: This coverage contains the conservation property boundaries of areas maintained by the Franklin County Conservation Board in Franklin County, Iowa. These were digitized based on parcels boundaries and legal descriptions found in the Franklin County Auditor's Office.
results.snippet: This digital, geographically referenced data set was developed by the Franklin County GIS Department to carry out county responsibilities related to management, protection, and development of Franklin County's conservation property.
